provenance_notes: Fine-tuned from braille_cell_gold_degraded.pt in lighting_robust/BrailleLens_LightingRobust_Colab.ipynb: offline lighting augmentation of the 12 Gold pages (relief relighting, directional light, shadows, low light + sensor noise, blur, glasses softening, JPEG, mirror flips) plus Braille-free negatives (inpainted Gold pages, COCO scenes). conf_threshold 0.40 from an app-faithful sweep of this UINT8 file (letterbox, NMS 0.40): held-out pages 10/11 F1 0.944 (current degraded model @0.25: 0.875), real low-light recall 0.978 (0.940), synthetic dark F1 0.854 (0.172), Braille-free test images 5.9 false boxes/img (58.2). See lighting_robust/results/.
flutter_notes: Preprocess: resize letterbox to 1280x1280, RGB, divide by 255. Postprocess: YOLO26 detection head, output already de-duplicated (end-to-end head) -- keep every row above conf_threshold (a page has many cells, unlike the fingertip model which only keeps the single best row). Box centers are the cell centroids.
